title: Gul-e-Noor

couple.invitationMessage: With the divine grace of Almighty Allah (SWT) and the cherished prayers of our beloved parents and elders, we request the honour of your gracious presence as our children unite in the sacred bond of Nikah.
couple.urduGreeting: Aapki pur-khuloos shirkat aur duayein hamari khushiyon ko dobala karengi.

venue.name: The Rosewood Heritage Palace
venue.address: Chhatarpur Heritage Boulevard, Mehrauli, New Delhi 110074

storyMessage: Like delicate rose petals blooming in morning dew, Allah (SWT) destined our hearts to unite in affection, tranquil peace, and barakah. Surrounded by the heartfelt prayers of our parents and elders, we begin this blessed journey of togetherness.

events.name: Jashn-e-Dholki & Phoolon Ki Mehendi
events.location: The Rosewood Heritage Palace, New Delhi
events.description: An enchanting rose-scented evening filled with traditional dholak beats, fragrant jasmine motiya garlands, and vibrant floral henna amidst laughter and elders' blessings.

events.name: The Sacred Nikah Ceremony (Ijab-o-Qubool)
events.location: The Rosewood Heritage Palace, New Delhi
events.description: The sacred covenant of Nikah solemnized under a canopy of blush roses, sealed with Quranic recitation, Ijab-o-Qubool, and lifelong promises.

events.name: Rukhsati & Royal Dawat-e-Walima Banquet
events.location: The Rosewood Heritage Palace, New Delhi
events.description: Tender parental prayers under the holy Quran followed by a radiant banquet celebrating the beautiful new beginning of two families with gourmet feast and starlight celebrations.

verse.translation: And We created you in pairs.
verse.propheticDua: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
verse.propheticDuaTranslation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness and eternal love.
